reply.emotion: excited and celebratory, waiting to blow the candles out
notes: In Mexico and many other Spanish-speaking countries, "pastel" specifically refers to a sweet, frosted birthday or celebration cake. For a smaller pastry or pie, "pastelito" or "tarta" is often used.

senses.definition: Postre dulce hecho con harina, azúcar, huevos y otros ingredientes, que se hornea y suele decorarse.

examples.text: Compramos un pastel de chocolate para su cumpleaños.
examples.translation: We bought a chocolate cake for his birthday.
examples.emotion: happy and eager, looking forward to eating dessert

senses.definition: Comida horneada que tiene una base de masa y un relleno salado, como de carne o verduras.

examples.text: El pastel de pollo está caliente y recién salido del horno.
examples.translation: The chicken pie is hot and fresh out of the oven.
examples.emotion: hungry and satisfied, smelling the warm food
